$comment: config.v1's types (spec/profiles/config/v1.md section 3). The zk2 subset of JSON Schema (core section 7.3). Objects are open: a later minor may add a member, and a reader ignores one it does not know. The two replies are discriminated unions: each branch requires a member no other branch has, so oneOf picks exactly one.

ParamValue.description: One parameter's value, untagged: a boolean, a signed 64-bit integer, or text (v1.md 2.2). No float: a value that needs one is an integer in a finer unit.

Class.description: Whether a group may change under a running service (v1.md 2.4): hot takes effect at once; reach decides whether the service can reach the bus, and is changed only under a window; contract is refused at runtime.

Source.description: Where a running value came from (v1.md 2.3): the owner's built-in default, its startup file, its persisted layer, or a change in this instance.

Time.description: An instant on the owner's clock: an RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, written with Z (v1.md 2.8).

Token.description: A change's name, minted by the owner, never reused by any instance of the service (v1.md 2.6).

Parameter.description: One parameter as the view shows it: its declaration, and what the owner runs with. Tagged by kind. A sensitive parameter never carries value or startup; a value the owner cannot read back is absent, never guessed (v1.md 2.2, 2.3, 2.15).

Group.description: One group: the parameters that change together, the unit a set addresses, with its class and whether the startup allowlist lets a set reach it (v1.md 2.2, 2.16).

Pending.description: The change applied, or armed, and not yet confirmed (v1.md 2.7): its token, its groups in the order they joined, the instant its undo runs, and whether every group of it is applied yet.

LastChange.description: The most recent change made permanent at runtime in this instance: confirmed, or applied without a window. Never a pending change (v1.md 2.6).

DesiredRefusal.description: Why the server did not converge a desired document, and where (v1.md 2.18).

DesiredReport.description: What the server did with the last desired document it acted on (v1.md 2.18): its revision, and converged, refused before anything applied, or failed partway.

ConfigView.description: The read-back (v1.md 2.3), state/view: the served schema and the running values in one document. A GET on it is the read. Never carries a sensitive value.

ConfigStatus.description: The compact status (v1.md 2.19), state/status: what a constrained face can afford. The values by group and name; a sensitive value, and one the owner cannot read back, is never present.

SetRequest.description: The body of @op/set/{group} (v1.md 2.5): values for some parameters of the group, and, each optional, the window, the pending change's token to join, the revision the caller read, a key that makes a retry return the first answer, and a dry run.

PendingReply.description: The reply to a set on a reach group, sent before the change is applied (v1.md 2.9): the change's token, when the group applies, and when the change rolls back unless confirmed.

SetReply.description: The reply to a set (v1.md 2.9): the read-back after the apply, or a dry run's would-be read-back; or, for a reach group, the pending reply before the apply.

ControlRequest.description: The body of confirm, cancel, extend and persist (v1.md 2.10, 2.13): the change's token; for extend alone, the new window from now; and which document the reply carries, the view by default.

ControlReply.description: The reply to confirm, cancel, extend and persist (v1.md 2.10): the read-back after the act, or the compact status when the request asked for it.

Edit.description: One parameter a change set (v1.md 2.17): its group and name, the value before the change and the value the change set. A sensitive parameter's edit is redacted, with neither value.

ConfigChangeEvent.description: One change, as it ended (v1.md 2.17), after RFC 6470's netconf-config-change: events/change/<ulid>. The attribution is what the change's caller claimed, never authentication.

ConfigError.description: The app detail of config.v1's operations (v1.md 2.5): restart-required for a contract group, device-refused with the device's words.

DesiredConfig.description: A desired document for a config.v1 server (v1.md 2.18), for an authoring service's own contract to carry: no config.v1 resource does. Values by group and name, under the author's revision.
